question: The mean proportional between (18 + 10sqrt{7}) { and } (18 - 4sqrt{7})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional between **a** and **b** is √(a × b).

Multiply the terms: (18 + 10√7)(18 − 4√7) = 324 − 72√7 + 180√7 − 40(7).

Simplify: 324 − 280 + 108√7 = 44 + 108√7.

Take square root: √(44 + 108√7).

**∴ The correct answer is √(44 + 108√7).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb9144f92464d5ed181bf5e0df6068797a777c8fbed98b59ab9e1e707ac32f92.png] 

**Given:**

First term (a) = (18 + 10√7)

Second term (b) = (18 − 4√7)

**Formula Used:**

Mean Proportional = √(a × b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean Proportional = √[(18 + 10√7) × (18 − 4√7)]

⇒ Mean Proportional = √[18(18 − 4√7) + 10√7(18 − 4√7)]

⇒ Mean Proportional = √[324 − 72√7 + 180√7 − (10 × 4 × 7)]

⇒ Mean Proportional = √[324 + 108√7 − 280]

⇒ Mean Proportional = √[44 + 108√7]

**∴ The correct answer is √(44 + 108√7).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion, then c is the third proportional and c = b²/a.

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a:b = c:d), then d is the fourth proportional and d = (b × c)/a.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b² and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a:√b.</p
